training_models: Each model family fits separate LONG and SHORT classifier, Strong-R regressor and Extreme-R regressor on 2023 resolved rows. Regime is an input feature; sleeve thresholds are selected separately.
score_reference: For each annual model version, component predictions are converted to percentiles against that direction and sleeve's resolved training prediction distribution.
per_sleeve_option_order: higher minimum of Strong PF and Extreme PF
sleeve_disable_rule: A sleeve with no 2024 option passing the per-sleeve gate is disabled for that model and score configuration.
configuration_order: higher minimum of combined Strong PF and Extreme PF
lower model complexity in frozen list order
one_position: Applied separately within each candidate sleeve after score gating. Opposite-direction simultaneity is preserved for audit and is not arbitrated until after unchanged 2025 confirmation.
